Sun & Moon series · CIN

Crimson Invasion

Released November 3, 2017 · 126 cards

Expanded

Crimson Invasion is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on November 3, 2017. Its main set has 111 cards, plus 15 secret rares numbered beyond the set (126 in total). It includes 108 Pokémon, 14 Trainer and 4 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

41 illustrators worked on Crimson Invasion. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (28), Kouki Saitou (5), Mitsuhiro Arita (5), Anesaki Dynamic (4), kirisAki (4), sui (4), tetsuya koizumi (4), TOKIYA (4).
